lines.zh: 我这么大一团，走路是滚的。
lines.en: A mass this big. I roll as I move.

lines.zh: 我飘过山脊，云被我撞散。
lines.en: I drift over the ridge, scattering clouds.

lines.zh: 我身上一堆小脑袋，都在看。
lines.en: A cluster of small heads. All watching.

lines.zh: 我朝前移动，慢，但压得住。
lines.en: Forward. Slow, but heavy.
Mountain wind can't shift me.
I drift around the peaks.
I grin. My mouth opens wide.
Debris falls as I move.

lines.zh: 我这么大一团，滚过去就行。
lines.en: A blob this big just rolls over.
I'm above you. Look up.

lines.zh: 我在这片荒地上慢慢巡。
lines.en: I patrol this badland slowly.

lines.zh: 我的影子把地盖住一片。
lines.en: My shadow covers a patch of ground.

lines.zh: 我悬着，身上的小脸都在笑。
lines.en: I hover. All my little faces grin.

lines.zh: 废料的味道，我闻着挺好。
lines.en: Scrap smells good to me.
Ultimate level. A big body.
Counting the heads on me.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，压得草伏下去。
lines.en: I hover, pressing the grass flat.
Dry mountain air. I'm used to it.

lines.zh: 我转了一圈，看有没有吃的。
lines.en: I turn once. Anything to eat?

lines.zh: 我的笑声很闷，在胸口里响。
lines.en: My laugh is muffled. It rumbles inside.

lines.zh: 我悬着，像挂在山上的一块布。
lines.en: I hang there like cloth on a mountain.

lines.zh: 地上有些铁皮，我捡过来。
lines.en: Scrap metal below. I'll take it.
This body is sturdy.
I laugh slowly. For a long time.
You looked up. I saw.

lines.zh: 我在想怎么把你包起来。
lines.en: Wondering how to wrap you up.

lines.zh: 你得仰头才看得见我的牙。
lines.en: You have to look up to see my teeth.
I lower a head and grin.

lines.zh: 我的笑脸上，针脚都绷开了。
lines.en: On my grin, the stitches strain open.

lines.zh: 我这一身脑袋都看着你。
lines.en: Every head on me is looking at you.
You're not running. Interesting.
Floating like this, I'm waiting.

lines.zh: 你的箭插在我身上，像根刺。
lines.en: Your arrow sticks in me like a thorn.

lines.zh: 我笑起来的时候，你别动。
lines.en: When I laugh, don't move.

lines.zh: 你想看我的脸？有很多张。
lines.en: Want to see my face? There are many.
I carry a smiley bomb.

lines.zh: 这么大一团，我闻你很清楚。
lines.en: A blob this size smells you clearly.
I'm here. You're not leaving.
Counting your legs. Four.

lines.zh: 你把头抬得那么高，累不累。
lines.en: Holding your head that high. Tired?

lines.zh: 我这一身碎片，都是捡来的。
lines.en: All this debris. I picked it up.

lines.zh: 你看起来像一块小点心。
lines.en: You look like a small snack.
A fragment fell off.
My laugh paused.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我这个体型不在乎。
lines.en: With this body, I don't care.
You hit one of my faces.

lines.zh: 我身上的补丁又裂开一道。
lines.en: Another seam splits on my patchwork body.

lines.zh: 我笑得整座山都在回响。
lines.en: My laugh echoes off the whole mountain.
It didn't break. Interesting.
Half a block back. Rare.

lines.zh: 一块布从我身上飘下来。
lines.en: A patch of cloth flutters off me.
That blow makes me laugh louder.
Scrap? I'll take all of it.
That smells of iron.
Higher. Let me sort it.
Too little. I'm this big.
I can swallow it. Don't be surprised.
Leave it. I'll take it myself.
Not good eating. Still taking it.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，口水流出来。
lines.en: I grinned. Drool ran out.
Don't pull back. I can reach.
From you, I won't be polite.
That little bit. Not worth a look.

lines.zh: 我张嘴的时候，你别伸手。
lines.en: Don't reach while my mouth is open.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肚皮上，滑了下去。
lines.en: You hit my belly and slide off.
I was barely moved.

lines.zh: 别贴着我，我身上都是硬的。
lines.en: Don't press. I'm all hard edges.
I've crowded you to the wall.
I float low. Right in the way.

lines.zh: 碰撞的声音很闷，像我笑了。
lines.en: A dull thud. Sounds like my laugh.

lines.zh: 这一下，我掉了几块碎片。
lines.en: That knocked off some fragments.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我一点没动。
lines.en: Two steps from you. Not one from me.
This big. Nowhere to yield.
You stepped on my debris.
This body is too heavy.
I don't need that.

lines.zh: 你要是靠过来，会被包住。
lines.en: Come close and you'd be wrapped up.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，不是那个意思。
lines.en: When I laugh, that's not what it means.

lines.zh: 你退开些，我这片影子太大。
lines.en: Step back. My shadow's too big.
I only eat and fight.

lines.zh: 你站远些，我低头看不见你。
lines.en: Stand far. I can't see you when I look down.
This badland fits only me.
One laugh. I turn away.
Don't stay in this badland.
One of my small heads lifts it.
Edible? Let me try.

lines.zh: 我吞下它，肚皮鼓了一下。
lines.en: I swallow it and my belly bulges.
I swallow all this scrap.
Debris turns inside me.
What you dropped went in my mouth.
Not enough.

lines.zh: 我举到最近的一张脸前面。
lines.en: Up to the nearest face.
Dropped in. It clinked.
It pricks. Good.

lines.zh: 我这么多眼睛都看见你。
lines.en: All these eyes see you.
Only you on this badland.
Every face turns to you.

lines.zh: 我飘过来，影子先罩住你。
lines.en: I drift over; my shadow covers you first.
You moved. Decided.
My laugh got louder.
No cover here.
Locked on. Won't loosen.
You're still giving off heat.
I'm far bigger than you.
Look up. I'm overhead.
Every face is grinning.
I press down, bit by bit.
You retreat. My shadow follows.
My laugh is above your head.

lines.zh: 我笑了一声，树上的鸟全飞了。
lines.en: I laugh once and every bird bolts.
Debris falls off me.
I know these mountains.
Behind the hill. I drift over.

lines.zh: 我一飘，就盖住整条小路。
lines.en: One drift and I cover the whole path.
I am made of fists.

lines.zh: 我一身都是拳头，压下来。
lines.en: I am all fists, pressing down.
A little closer is all I need.
Close enough to press down.
I press down and the ground cracks.
I grin and slam in.
You bounced and rolled far.

lines.zh: 我身上的小脑袋一起咬。
lines.en: Every head on me bites at once.

lines.zh: 这一下很重，我自己都知道。
lines.en: Heavy. Even I know it.
You retreat. I press on.
I spat out debris.

lines.zh: 这一下把你的护肩拍扁了。
lines.en: That flattened your pauldron.

lines.zh: 我攥起拳头，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I ball my fist and punch out a crater.
Smiley Bomb — right on you.
Still moving. I press again.
I left a crater.
I drift out of the mountain pass.

lines.zh: 巨大的身影挡住了太阳。
lines.en: A huge shape blocks the sun.

lines.zh: 我身上的头一个个睁眼。
lines.en: My heads open their eyes one by one.
The laugh arrives first.
I hover and look around.
This badland is mine to patrol.

lines.zh: 我飘过来，地上的碎片跟着。
lines.en: I drift in. Debris follows.

lines.zh: 我身上还有别的东西的味道。
lines.en: Something else's smell on me.

lines.zh: 我一转，整个影子都动了。
lines.en: One turn and the whole shadow moves.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我已经在了。
lines.en: I was there when you looked up.
One laugh. Very loud.
I drifted here from far away.
Fire on me. I laughed once.

lines.zh: 我压塌了一片灌木，还在笑。
lines.en: I flatten a patch of bushes, still grinning.
I can't float. Water's heavy.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得转了一圈。
lines.en: The blast spun me a full turn.

lines.zh: 这东西扎进去，我笑得更欢。
lines.en: It lodges in me and I laugh harder.

lines.zh: 这力量让我的头都闭嘴了。
lines.en: That quieted every head of mine.
No scrap to eat. I'm weakening.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，碎片全飞了。
lines.en: Lightning. Debris flew everywhere.

lines.zh: 往下掉，我这么大也挡不住。
lines.en: Falling. Even this big.
